verdict.rationale: Lever ships AI features (Talent Fit matching, AI interview transcripts, AI Form Builder), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out, a data-use control, or a no-training commitment for customer data. Cross-customer benchmark insights are a different feature and are not evidence of a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
